summary: Adopt the expanded MIR 4.2 programme and portable in-game research-surface architecture.
details: Expand the canonical 4.2 outcome to complete qualified material routes, useful progression, localized explanations, auditable profiles, current integrations and recoverable delivery.
Add six OmniAB, eight RIC and one portable-player-surface request to the active 81-request authority.
Keep in-surface filter, sort and personal hide state presentation-only; document the installed engine boundary against direct vanilla-tree extension.
Prefer a public extension contract with a maintained research UI before a separately downloadable companion; retain a full OEM+ tree and queue as an evidence-led 4.5 candidate.
Require one canonical copied-data core, one visible UI host, no second emitter, no private third-party GUI mutation and no new hard dependency for MIR.
